image_description: A large, ornate pipe organ situated within a stone archway, likely in a church or cathedral. The organ features a symmetrical arrangement of vertical metal pipes of varying heights, with the tallest pipes in the center creating a stepped silhouette. Below the pipes is a wooden gallery structure with decorative paneling and doors. Above the organ, projected light patterns resembling clouds or floral motifs are visible on the arched ceiling.

The connection points where the pipes meet the wooden rackboard are somewhat indistinct and blurry. Some pipes appear to merge slightly into the background or each other rather than having crisp, distinct mounting points.
The green railing in the foreground has slight irregularities in bar thickness and alignment, typical of minor AI geometric inconsistencies.
